text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Greek composer Mikis Theodorakis to conduct Zorba the Greek in the Macedonian National Theatre in Skopje on Saturday.
- Macedonian Foreign Minister Ljubomir Frckoski to make a two-day official visit to France on Tuesday where he is expected to seek support for extension of UNPREDEP mandate in Macedonia.
- Macedonian Foreign Minister Ljubomir Frckoski sent a letter to NATO asking for Macedonia's admission as permanent member of the Alliance. He will address North Alliance Council in Brussels.

- Secretary General of the Council of Europe Daniel Tarschys opened the Council's information centre in Skopje. Tarschys said Europe respected Macedonia's efforts to improve its inter-ethnic relations. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +381 11 222 4305
